title: Paradise X Wizard Special Edition Marvel 2001 Alex Ross Cover Earth X Preview
condition_description: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Paradise X Wizard Special Edition (Marvel / Wizard, 2001). Preview special for Alex Ross and Jim Krueger's Paradise X, the final part of the Earth X trilogy. Painted Alex Ross cover with Wolverine, Spider-Man, Iron Man and Captain Marvel.

Back cover: Twisted ToyFare Theatre trade paperback ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
